name: 組織設定カテゴリを切り替えるサイドナビゲーション
prompt:
Recreate the supplied reference as a faithful, clean Japanese localization of the same GitHub organization Settings left sidebar crop. The reference crop is exactly 414 by 1004 pixels, a very tall narrow 0.412:1 aspect ratio. Preserve that very narrow vertical canvas and use the full frame; do not widen it or add blank bands, surrounding page, browser chrome, repository header, central content, invite table, or footer.

Match the original geometry, compact row heights, 20 px left inset, icon placement, line lengths, divider positions, gray icon strokes, pale separators, white background, restrained GitHub blue selection marker, and typography weight hierarchy. Only translate the visible labels into Japanese; keep the same order and visible states.

From top to bottom: a small gear icon and 「一般」, then a thin divider; muted bold section label 「アクセス」; an active 「コラボレーター」 row with a group icon, bold text, pale gray rounded highlight, and a thin vivid blue vertical selection bar at the far-left edge; an unselected speech-bubble row 「モデレーションオプション」 with an upward caret showing it expanded; two indented child rows 「インタラクション制限」 and 「コードレビュー制限」 with no extra icons; a thin divider; heading 「コードと自動化」; rows 「ブランチ」 with branch-node icon, 「タグ」 with tag icon, 「ルール」 with a down caret, 「アクション」 with a down caret and play-in-circle icon, 「Webhooks」 with a webhook icon, 「環境」 with a server icon, 「Codespaces」 with a monitor icon, and 「Pages」 with a window icon; a thin divider; heading 「セキュリティ」; rows 「コードセキュリティと分析」 with a security/search icon, 「デプロイキー」 with a key icon, and 「シークレットと変数」 with a small settings icon and down caret; a thin divider; heading 「インテグレーション」; rows 「GitHub Apps」 with an app icon and 「メール通知」 with an envelope icon, cropped closely at the bottom just as in the reference.

Keep all icons simple, small, monochrome gray outline icons aligned consistently to the source. Preserve the original hierarchy and density without making anything larger or bolder than shown. The selected collaborator row is the only active highlight. The expanded Moderation options children stay indented and the Rules, Actions, and Secrets and variables rows stay collapsed. No extra labels, badges, buttons, cards, shadows, or decorative elements.
reviewNotes: Source-crop comparison passed: the Japanese sidebar preserves every row, selected Collaborators state, expanded Moderation options, collapsed Rules/Actions/Secrets states, separators, and tight bottom crop. Candidate 805x1953 vs source 414x1004 (uniform scale, less than 0.05 percent aspect-ratio difference); no material layout drift.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
